title: Flow with capacity upgrades triggered by threshold usage

params.EDGES: e1(cap=27, cost=12); e2(cap=45, cost=7); e3(cap=29, cost=1)

text: A network has a single source and sink with parallel edges described by: e1(cap=27, cost=12); e2(cap=45, cost=7); e3(cap=29, cost=1). You must send 89 units.
